card_title: Artist Notes: Stainless Steel Cosmetic Spatula
summary: Clinical cross-contamination prevention. A surgical-grade mixing tool designed to safely extract creams and mix foundation shades.
description: Aesthetic hygiene protocol. Dipping fingers directly into jars introduces aggressive bacterial loads that degrade the formula. This tool allows for the sterile extraction and manipulation of your highest-fidelity products.
technical_overview: Offered at $15.0 for 1 Unit, this KoColor OTHER is expertly formulated with 316L Surgical Stainless Steel. It delivers a high-fidelity Steel Silver color profile (`#D3D3D3`) and leverages non-porous sterilization capability.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Use the flat edge to scoop creams from jars, or to mix two distinct foundation shades on the back of the hand.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Swipe the edge of the spatula thinly across the cheek to deposit a micro-layer of foundation, resulting in the most natural, skin-like application possible.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: 316L Stainless Steel is entirely non-porous and highly resistant to oxidation, meaning it can be aggressively sanitized with 70% isopropyl alcohol indefinitely.
